name: GroupDock
summary: Group apps into a Dock stack that opens as a fan
description:
GroupDock puts several apps in one stack of the Dock. Click it and the apps open in the Dock's own fan, with its animation, and it closes like any stack.

Create a group, pick its apps and their order, choose fan, grid or list, then add it to the Dock. Apps you add or move later reach the stack at once.
